card.summary: "Try free for 7 days - no charge until your trial ends", on a "Tunnel $8/mo" plan that "Includes 1 static IP" and "First 7 days free".

free_tier.stated: "Try free for 7 days - no charge until your trial ends", on a "Tunnel $8/mo" plan that "Includes 1 static IP" and "First 7 days free".

egress.terms: "Unlimited data" appears in the list of what is included with every tunnel. No fair-use figure accompanies it.; ingress: tcp+udp

record.interface_detail: Config file, QR code and a dashboard for IP and reverse DNS management.
record.tooling: wg-quick; config plus QR code for phones
record.chaining: Incoming-only mode leaves the local outbound path untouched, so it composes with a free-tier VM that already has outbound.

limits.value: unlimited data, no fair-use figure stated

record.binding_note: Nothing in the published terms fails at 1 TiB/month: data is unlimited, every port and protocol is open, and the plan is one address at USD 8. The unstated fair-use policy behind "unlimited" is the only risk, and it is not documented.

identity_cost.detail: The trial starts at account.getrealip.net with a signup form and "no charge until your trial ends", which implies a card is taken at signup; the form itself was not read.

record.reliability_note: No throttle or ban policy published; the absence of a fair-use clause is undocumented rather than guaranteed.
record.confidence_note: Price, the unlimited-data claim, the config file and the port policy are first-party.

evidence.proved: USD 8/mo for 1 static IPv4 and an IPv6 range, unlimited data, any protocol and any port, WireGuard config with QR code, 7 days free; additional IP USD 4/mo
"Any protocol, any port - not just HTTP"; "Full tunnel or incoming only"; USD 8 first IP, USD 4 additional; 7-day free trial

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 8 per month for one IPv4 and an IPv6 range, unlimited data; 7 days free
record.notes: Provides dedicated IPv4 addresses with unmetered bandwidth at USD 8 monthly, with no port blocking.

extras.wg_detail: "WireGuard config + QR code" is a listed feature of the USD 8 plan, and "Full tunnel or incoming only" is offered: "use your static IP for all traffic, or just receive inbound while keeping your normal internet for outbound (requires OS routing policy support)".
extras.volume_stated: "Unlimited data" appears in the list of what is included with every tunnel. No fair-use figure accompanies it.
extras.transit_note: The vendor routes the address to the tunnel from its own network in six regions.
